SELECT s."Id", s."Name", s."ContributionAmount", s.xmin AS "Version", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM "StokvelMembers" AS s0
    WHERE s0."StokvelId" = s."Id") AS "MemberCount", (
    SELECT s1."Role"
    FROM "StokvelMembers" AS s1
    WHERE s1."StokvelId" = s."Id" AND s1."UserId" = @userId
    LIMIT 1) AS "Role"
FROM "Stokvels" AS s
WHERE s."Id" = @stokvelId
LIMIT 1

SELECT c."Id", c."EndDate", c."Period", c."Status", c."StokvelId", c."TargetAmount", c.xmin, c0."Id", c0."Amount", c0."ContributionCycleId", c0."RecordedAtUtc", c0."Status", c0."StokvelId", c0."UserId", c0.xmin
FROM "ContributionCycles" AS c
LEFT JOIN "Contributions" AS c0 ON c."Id" = c0."ContributionCycleId"
WHERE c."StokvelId" = @stokvelId
ORDER BY c."Period" DESC, c."Id" DESC

SELECT c."Period", c."Status", c."EndDate", c."TargetAmount", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT c0."UserId"
        FROM "Contributions" AS c0
        WHERE c."Id" = c0."ContributionCycleId"
    ) AS c1) AS "MembersPaid", COALESCE((
    SELECT COALESCE(sum(c2."Amount"), 0.0)
    FROM "Contributions" AS c2
    WHERE c."Id" = c2."ContributionCycleId"), 0.0) AS "Collected"
FROM "ContributionCycles" AS c
WHERE c."StokvelId" = @stokvelId AND c."Period" = @period
ORDER BY c."Status" = 'Open' DESC, c."Id"
LIMIT 1

SELECT c1."Id", c1."EndDate", c1."Period", c1."Status", c1."StokvelId", c1."TargetAmount", c1.xmin, c0."Id", c0."Amount", c0."ContributionCycleId", c0."RecordedAtUtc", c0."Status", c0."StokvelId", c0."UserId", c0.xmin
FROM (
    SELECT c."Id", c."EndDate", c."Period", c."Status", c."StokvelId", c."TargetAmount", c.xmin
    FROM "ContributionCycles" AS c
    WHERE c."Id" = @id
    LIMIT 1
) AS c1
LEFT JOIN "Contributions" AS c0 ON c1."Id" = c0."ContributionCycleId"
ORDER BY c1."Id"

SELECT c0."Id", c0."StokvelId", c0."UserId", u."Name", u."Email", s."Role", c0."ContributionCycleId", c0."Amount", c0."Status", c0."RecordedAtUtc", c0.xmin AS "Version"
FROM (
    SELECT c."Id", c."Amount", c."ContributionCycleId", c."RecordedAtUtc", c."Status", c."StokvelId", c."UserId", c.xmin
    FROM "Contributions" AS c
    WHERE c."StokvelId" = @stokvelId AND c."ContributionCycleId" = @contributionCycleId
    ORDER BY c."RecordedAtUtc" DESC, c."Id" DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS c0
INNER JOIN "StokvelMembers" AS s ON c0."UserId" = s."UserId" AND c0."StokvelId" = s."StokvelId"
INNER JOIN "Users" AS u ON s."UserId" = u."Id"
ORDER BY c0."RecordedAtUtc" DESC, c0."Id" DESC
